annotation.justification: The clause is clear in its requirement that the HTTP2-Settings header field must be sent as a connection option in the Connection header field to prevent it from being forwarded. It references Section 6.1 of [RFC7230], which provides normative context. There is no ambiguity in the language or in the required implementation behavior.
